lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Noob!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Noob, noob!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Something's wrong...
What happened?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I need to meet someone soon,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: but something came up at work

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and I don't think I can leave.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Can you go instead?
Who do you need to meet?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's this kid in the Ark

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: who goes by the nickname "Cockadoodledoo".

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: We're supposed to meet in 30 minutes.
What do I need to do when I meet him?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I'm pretty sure he's just a kid

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: so just give him a good scare!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: We're gaming buddies,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: but during an important raid,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I was the first to get killed!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That wouldn't have happened if he'd had my back!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I was pretty peeved, so we were getting into it in the chat,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: and eventually decided to duke it out face-to-face.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Grrr...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I still can't believe it.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: They should have covered me so the deal could go down!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Am I crazy for thinking this?
You should have closed all your deals before you died.
Where was your healer?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You've got a point,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I was on a roll, so maybe I was acting recklessly.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Actually, I've got no beef with this kid.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: It's solo raids for me from now on.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: You're right!

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: The healer was right beside me twiddling his thumbs.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I shouldn't be fighting this kid

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: What was that healer's nickname again?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Anyway...

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I think we can call off the duel for now.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Way to use your noggin,

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: noob!
